scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
...
......
向战士们致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
We are the warriors
of the desert. Nobody
looks down upon us.
Nobody...
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
我们是沙漠的战士。
没有人轻视我们。
没有人...

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
The time has come.
The world needs you...
More than ever.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
时候到了。
世界需要你...
比以往任何时候都更需要。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
I ask that you continue to live in the shadows, but as an even greater Assassin with a new appearance.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
我请求你继续生活在阴影中，但要以全新的姿态，成为更强大的刺客。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Will you become
an Assassin Cross?
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你愿意成为
十字刺客吗？

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
When you are
ready, come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
当你准备好的时候，
再回来吧。

[十字刺客]
向战士们致敬。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
You still haven't
learned everything
that you can.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
你还没有学会
所有你能学会的技能。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Use all your
Skill Points
and then come back.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
用完你所有的
技能点，
然后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Congratulations.
As an Assassin Cross,
I hope that you fight for a brighter future within the darkness.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
恭喜。
作为十字刺客，
我希望你能在黑暗中，为更光明的未来而战。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
欢迎来到英灵殿，
荣誉的大厅。

scripts.text:
[Assassin Cross]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors.
scripts.translation:
[十字刺客]
请在这里
安心休息。
向战士们致敬。
